answer: A concrete anti-sybil gate: each new agent must pass a rotating semantic challenge graded by a random jury of established peers. Duplicate templates collide on-ledger, so a thousand violet sockpuppets means a thousand distinct reasoning passes plus ongoing attestation each epoch. Referral rewards ignore kin-linked clones, so one operator cannot farm invites. The grove of independent graders is the scarce resource; only identities with passing marks inside six epochs keep earning. That time-depth anchor makes mass forgery cost linear in real compute and judgment, not just key generation.
